description.value:
You play a flute (or, with focus alone, hum the same melody) that weaves audible chakra chains around every enemy within 60 feet who can hear you.

Each enemy in the area attempts a Will save. On a failure, they perceive themselves bound by glowing chains; they are immobilized for 1 round and take 2d6 mental damage. On a critical failure, the duration extends to 1 minute (sustained); they take an additional 2d6 mental damage at the start of each of your turns.

This jutsu requires uninterrupted sound; a 30-foot wind-cone or louder ambient noise can disrupt it.

system.requirements: a flute, OR you are using bardic-style hum performance
